recognize_zh: 成群的中型芽細胞（blasts），細胞核一側有明顯凹陷、凹陷處呈淡染的「杯口」狀（cup-like nuclear invagination），細胞質中等量、淡藍色、顆粒稀少，是與 NPM1 突變相關的 cup-like blasts。
features: Medium to large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio arranged in loose clusters
Nuclei with a prominent cup-shaped invagination forming a pale clear zone (>25% of nuclear area) on one side
Fine, open chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Moderate amount of pale blue agranular to finely granular cytoplasm
Occasional smaller cells with dense, purple granular nuclei, possibly degenerating or smudged cells
Background echinocytic (crenated) red cells, likely artifact; no platelets conspicuous
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating blasts arranged in clusters. The blasts are medium-sized with moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing few or no granules, fine nuclear chromatin, and a distinctive cup-shaped nuclear invagination creating a pale perinuclear clear zone. No Auer rods or maturing granulocytes are evident in this field, and the background red cells show crenation. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blast morphology, which is suggestive of NPM1 mutation (with or without FLT3-ITD); molecular confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Hypogranular APL shows bilobed or butterfly-shaped (sliding-plate) nuclei with occasional Auer rod bundles and strong MPO, rather than a single cup-like invagination; PML::RARA testing separates them.
Promonocytes have delicately folded, convoluted nuclei and more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles, lacking the sharply punched-out cup-like clear zone.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and are MPO-negative with B/T-lineage markers on flow; cup-like nuclei are rare.
Cup-like blasts can occur in FLT3-ITD AML without NPM1 mutation, so only molecular testing (NPM1 exon 12, FLT3) resolves the genotype.
